newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit rangebound, dollar gains again capped.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit rangebound, dollar gains again capped.

text.p: The ringgit stayed within a tight range thoughout Asian trading as the dollar's rise was again capped by selling out of Kuala Lumpur, dealers said.
They said a U.S. investment fund was also heard selling dollar/ringgit at 2.5170 level.
"Dollar/ringgit again did not go anywhere," said a European bank dealer in Kuala Lumpur. "It was stuck between 2.5140 and 2.5170. There was good selling interest on either side of the range."
Dealers said U.S. funds out of Hong Kong were seen buying back the dollar/ringgit around 2.5140 level.
They said there had been good buying interest from U.S. funds at that level in the last couple of weeks.
The dollar's firmness against the yen had earlier supported the dollar/ringgit.
Dealers said immediate gains for the dollar/ringgit were likely to be capped at 2.5200 while downside was seen limited to the 2.5140 level.
For the near term, dealers were expecting the dollar/ringgit to continue trading in the 2.5050-2.5200 range.
At 0930 GMT, the ringgit was quoted at 2.5145/55 a dollar against 2.5150/60 at close in Kuala Lumpur on Friday.
